description: Source file implementing debugging utilities for lazy tensor graph visualization and environment configuration in the torch::lazy namespace.

classes.name: DebugUtil
classes.description: Utility class providing functions for debugging tensor graphs, environment configuration, and experiment toggles.

methods.name: GetEnvString
methods.description: Retrieves environment variable value or default.

methods.name: DefaultGraphFormat
methods.description: Determines default graph format based on environment variable.

methods.name: LoadExperiments
methods.description: Loads set of enabled experiments from environment variable.

methods.name: GetDefaultGraphFormat
methods.description: Returns the default graph format setting.

methods.name: GetFirstUserFrameInPython
methods.description: Retrieves the first user frame in the Python call stack, excluding site-packages.

methods.name: GetTensorsGraphInfo
methods.description: Generates a string representation of tensor graph info in specified format.

methods.name: SaveTensorsGraphInfo
methods.description: Saves tensor graph info to a file if environment variable is set.

methods.name: ExperimentEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific experiment is enabled based on environment variable.
